summary.intent: Verify the end-to-end migration pipeline from CipherBox storage to an external IPFS node (and back), plus validate dual-write capability in the BYO IPFS node feature.
summary.outcome: A bug was found and fixed in the migration processor (wrong env var name), two plan SUMMARYs (21-06, 21-07) were completed, but the full end-to-end migration data transfer through the TEE worker remained unverified — the actual pin transfer to the 2nd Kubo node was never confirmed.

repo: The migration processor uses TEE_AUTH_SECRET but TeeService uses TEE_WORKER_SECRET — these env var names were inconsistent, causing silent processor failures.
BullMQ migration jobs that fail do not auto-retry; a new migration must be triggered manually.
The migration trigger logic checks previousMode === mode — switching external→cipherbox→external won't re-trigger migration on the second external save because savedConfig is already 'external'.
Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) is complete at 7/7 plans; benchmark execution against a real external provider (21-07 Task 4) is deferred pending provider infrastructure.

code.finding: Used TEE_AUTH_SECRET instead of TEE_WORKER_SECRET, mismatching the env var name used by TeeService elsewhere in the codebase.

workflow: NestJS hot-reload (watch mode) recompiles changed files but does not re-queue already-failed BullMQ jobs — failed jobs require a manual retrigger.
When debugging multi-service pipelines (UI → API → BullMQ → TEE worker → IPFS), it's worth confirming each layer independently before running end-to-end.
Playwright browser automation was used for UAT of the storage settings UI flow alongside API-level log inspection.

friction: Env var name mismatch (TEE_AUTH_SECRET vs TEE_WORKER_SECRET) caused the migration processor to fail silently with no obvious error until logs were checked.
Failed BullMQ jobs don't retry, requiring a workaround of toggling mode cipherbox→external to trigger a fresh migration — but this also failed because savedConfig was already 'external'.
The MigrationProgress component continued showing the stale '0/38 pins' state from the failed job, making it hard to confirm whether a new migration had started.
The TEE worker's /migrate endpoint integration (decrypt ECIES config, fetch CIDs, pin to destination) was never actually exercised during this session.
open_items: Verify full end-to-end migration: pins actually landing on 2nd Kubo node after TEE worker processes the job.
Fix the migration retrigger UX — UI should detect a previously failed migration and offer a retry button rather than requiring a mode toggle.
Test dual-write capability (writes going to both CipherBox and external node simultaneously).
Run 21-07 benchmark scenarios against a real external IPFS provider (deferred pending BYO_IPFS_ENDPOINT infrastructure).
Commit the TEE_AUTH_SECRET → TEE_WORKER_SECRET processor fix (was applied but commit was pending at end of transcript).
